title: TikTok: What does it cost to become an airline pilot? (Video 1)

lines.text: What does it really cost to become an airline pilot? The final number is insane.
The medical exam alone: hundreds of euros.
Flight school: up to one hundred eighty thousand euros.
Plus two years of living costs, with barely any time for a side job.
Then many airlines want a type rating. Up to forty thousand more.
Total: well over two hundred thousand euros. Would you pay it?
